title: WhatsApp Catalogue Categories and Your Business Category
description: WhatsApp catalogue categories explained: make collections for your products, and set the right business category on your WhatsApp Business profile.
h1: WhatsApp Catalogue Categories: How to Group Products and Pick a Business Category
answer: WhatsApp has two kinds of category. Catalogue categories are called collections. You make one from your catalogue, name it and pick its items, and WhatsApp says it reviews it within 24 hours. Your business category is different. It sits on your business profile, and you can pick up to three from WhatsApp's list.
waText: Hi OneCatalog, I need help with categories in my WhatsApp catalogue.

blocks.p: When people say "WhatsApp category", they mean one of two things.

table.caption: The two kinds of WhatsApp category
head: Catalogue collections
Business profile category
rows: Groups your products, like "Sofas" or "Silk sarees"
Tells customers what kind of business you are, like a furniture store
No. You pick from WhatsApp's list.

sections.h2: How to create WhatsApp catalogue categories (collections)

blocks.p: You need products in your catalogue first. Our guide on [how to add a catalog to WhatsApp Business](/guides/add-catalog-to-whatsapp-business) covers that step. Then:

ol: Tap the menu, then **Collections**, then the add icon.
Type a name for the collection, like "Dining sets".
Pick the products that belong in it.

blocks.alt: Creating a new collection in the WhatsApp Business catalogue
blocks.capture: Android. Tools > Catalog > menu > Collections > add icon, on the screen where you type the collection name.

blocks.p: **How to check it worked:** WhatsApp reviews each new collection against its Commerce Policy and says this should take no more than 24 hours. After that, open your catalogue on another phone. The collection name should show with its products.
All of these start from the Collections screen: **Tools**, then **Catalog**, the menu, then **Collections**.

table.caption: Managing collections in WhatsApp Business
head: To do this
What to tap
rows: Tap the collection, open its product list, tick or untick products, then **Done**
Tap the collection, tap the menu, then **Reorder**. Drag products, then **Save**
Tap the menu, then **Reorder**. Drag collections, then **Save**
Tap the collection, tap the menu, then **Rename**. Type the new name and tap **Save**
Press and hold the collection, tap the menu, then **Delete**

blocks.p: If a collection won't delete, WhatsApp suggests removing all its products first, then deleting the empty collection.

sections.h2: How to choose good catalogue categories

blocks.p: Name categories the way customers ask for things, not the way your stock register lists them. A customer asks for "silk sarees", not "Group 14".

ul: **Keep it short.** 4 to 8 categories are easier to browse than 20.
**Use one rule.** Split by product type, like sofas, beds and dining sets. Don't mix type and price in one list.
**Put best sellers first.** Reorder so the most asked-for category is at the top.

table.caption: Example categories by trade
head: Trade
Example categories
rows: Sofas, Sofa sets, Beds, Dining sets, Wardrobes, Office chairs
Silk sarees, Cotton sarees, Dress material, Kids wear
Floor tiles, Wall tiles, Sanitaryware, CP fittings

blocks.callout: **What we see with real shops:** owners often make one collection per supplier, because that is how stock arrives. Customers don't know your suppliers. Group by what the product is, because that is what customers look for.

sections.h2: How to set your WhatsApp business category

blocks.p: Your business category shows on your business profile. It tells a new customer what you sell before they read anything else.

ol: Tap the **Category** field. On iPhone it is called **Categories**.
Pick up to three categories that fit your business. Tap a category again to remove it.

blocks.alt: Business category field on a WhatsApp Business profile
blocks.capture: Android. Tools > Profile, with the Category field open and a few categories ticked.

blocks.p: WhatsApp says you can't make a custom category. If yours isn't in the list, pick a more general one, or **Other Business**.

sections.h2: Can one product be in more than one collection?

blocks.p: WhatsApp's help page doesn't say either way. Try adding the product to a second collection from the Collections screen. If it lets you, it works.

sections.h2: Why is my new collection missing?

blocks.p: It is probably still in review. WhatsApp says collection review should take no more than 24 hours. Also check that the collection has products in it, and that those products are approved and not hidden. Our guide to a [WhatsApp catalogue not showing](/guides/whatsapp-catalog-not-showing) covers each case.

In a OneCatalog catalogue, we set up the categories for you when we build it, and there is no review wait. Each category also gets its own web page that customers and Google can open.
